thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed from control plane dependencies (auth, org-lookup, billing). Threshold breached: 5xx rate > 8% over 2m across prod regions. Auto-paging oncall.

dawn.oncall: acked. grabbing context — which region/service is spiking? @ben.sre please triage.

ben.sre: seeing a mix of 502/504 from gateway -> auth-proxy and org-lookup fanout. Logs show repeated upstream timeout: `upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream` from edge-gateway.

alice.ops: spike started ~2088888600 (about 5m ago). Traffic didn't drop — roughly 12% of requests failing for POST /v1/controlplane/* routes. Embedding and generation unaffected.

carla.engineering: reproduction locally: sending org lookup with heavy concurrent requests causes org-lookup to stall at 95th percentile, thread pool saturation. We pushed a dev trace: `org-lookup:db_query_wait > 1200ms` and backlog in billing client retries.

sam.platform: billing service is also reporting elevated latency -> many retries cascade back into auth clients. I see a retry loop that increases qps to org-lookup. We have a small circuit-breaker but it's not tripping due to short error bursts.

dawn.oncall: immediate mitigations I can run now: 1) adjust gateway circuit-breaker to lower maxConcurrent and faster open, 2) apply emergency rate-limit on internal controlplane routes, 3) disable non-essential billing syncs. Thoughts?

ben.sre: do 1+2 now. For 3 we need product OK but it's low risk — go ahead after notify. Also we should enable fallback cache for org-lookup for reads.

dawn.oncall: running commands now: 
```
# lower gateway concurrent to reduce fanout
kubectl -n edge patch deploy edge-gateway -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"ops.temporal/override":"cb-1"}}}}}'
# apply ingress rate-limit for /v1/controlplane
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: temp-rate-limit
data:
  routes: |
    - path: /v1/controlplane
      limit: 200rps
EOF
```

incident-bot: note: dawn.oncall executed: gateway patch, rate-limit config applied. Alerts suppressed for 10m to avoid noise.

alice.ops: seeing 5xx drop to ~5% within 90s, latency tail slowly improving. Good signal from EU region.

carla.engineering: enabling org-lookup cache hit fallback in runtime. Patch sent: toggled `org_lookup.enable_fallback=true` in configmap and restarted 2/3 replicas.

sam.platform: billing team confirmed non-critical background jobs can be paused. Pausing batch-sync queue -> reducing retry storm.

jordan-support: customer impact: At peak ~1.3k requests/min affected (~8% of global controlplane traffic). A handful of customers in EU/APAC saw provisioning errors and higher latencies. No data loss reported. Recording for incident page.

ben.sre: attaching short logs from gateway and org-lookup:
```
[2026-08-19T14:21:05Z] gateway: upstream timeout to org-lookup-01: 504
[2026-08-19T14:21:08Z] org-lookup: db_query_wait=1320ms queue_len=87
[2026-08-19T14:21:12Z] billing-client: retrying charge-check id=xx status=429 -> queued
```

dawn.oncall: running a targeted restart of org-lookup pod with id org-lookup-02 to clear stuck connections.

carla.engineering: rolling restart initiated, watchers confirm readiness. We'll watch for increased cache misses as replicas recycle.

alice.ops: after restart, 5xx rate down to ~2.2% and tail latencies recovering. Some customers still seeing errors, likely cached transactions failing earlier.

ben.sre: root cause hypothesis: a cascading retry loop from billing sync spikes caused short-term DB contention in org-lookup (slow queries) -> threadpool exhaustion -> gateway timeouts. Circuit breaker thresholds were permissive so the fanout amplified.

sam.platform: action items I'm tracking:
- implement backoff on billing client retries (short term config)
- tune circuit-breaker to open earlier on error rate
- add bulkhead to org-lookup to isolate blocking flows

dawn.oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @ben.sre please take lead for remediation & postmortem. I'll leave monitoring on. Pager suppressed until next alert.

ben.sre: taking handoff. I'll keep the incident channel open for follow-ups. Assigning owner for postmortem: carla.engineering. Reminder to notify product/security if any customer escalations.

jordan-support: already prepared customer comms draft and impact table. Will wait for final log counts before sending.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> degraded (errors reduced below threshold). Incident ticket created: INC-2088. Owner: ben.sre. SLA impact: transient errors for ~18m window. Recording metrics snapshot.

carla.engineering: notes for postmortem: include timeline, circuit-breaker tuning history, billing retry policy, and a follow-up TODO to add synthetic probes for org-lookup saturation.

ben.sre: closing notes: if error rate creeps back above 3% re-open pager. Thanks everyone for fast responses. :thumbsup:

dawn.oncall: ack handoff. ping me if it flares.
